# DNSquachWatch v1.5.7 — ST7789 / ILI9341, 80 MHz

This release brings the fixes developed since v1.5.2 to both supported CYD display models.

- **Wi-Fi and location labels:** connected-network labeling, explicit save results and connection-only behavior preserve DNSP's time/location workflow without automatically opening Update Check.
- **Storage and recovery:** coordinated storage operations, backup maintenance/archive tools, checked microSD content contracts for OTA, and device-health reporting improve recovery and update handling.
- **Simulation identification:** the DNSP `<OUI>:00:00:00` test-address convention marks matching detections and carries that status through details, history, readable logs, research exports and paired incidents. Normal classification, confidence, thresholds and Ignore behavior remain unchanged. This convention is not an authenticated identity or a globally reserved address.
- **Responsiveness:** automatic readable-history refresh runs after display/input, pauses during touch and alerts, spaces processing steps, and alternates CRC-checked checkpoints. The latest follow-up removes repeated schema lookups and identifies the actual slow step plus its slowest storage operation in serial diagnostics.
- **Consistent versions:** splash, System Info, new reports, backup metadata, signed update manifests and both flashing kits identify v1.5.7. Stored data-format versions retain their existing names for compatibility.

Download the kit for your display. Each includes all four flashing binaries. Keep the existing **DNSP Content/v1.5/** on microSD: there are no content changes. Normal flashing requires no erase and preserves settings, PIN/duress state and onboard history. Serial diagnostics use **115200 baud**.

Both ESP32 builds, all 53 host test groups, display/UI checks, version checks, package checksums and signing checks passed. ST7789 hardware testing through v1.5.6 showed improved responsiveness and a successful simulated-alert dismissal. Physical-card pauses remain under investigation; v1.5.7 adds more precise measurements and does not claim to eliminate all stalls. ILI9341 hardware confirmation, PIN/duress regression testing on a spare unit, Avata 2 field testing and human translation review remain pending.

Original SquachWatch: Talking Sasquach / skizzophrenic. DNSP modifications: dnsprincess. Research acknowledgements remain in the project README.
